extDescription.message: Shares individual tabs with the Hermes agent; the connection runs through your own relay.

actionTitle.message: Hermes Tabs: share / revoke this tab

optSaved.message: Saved. If the badge on the icon is empty, the connection is up.

optEnabled.message: Enabled (off: Hermes cannot do anything in the browser)

optActionsHelp.message: Hermes may read anywhere in its tabs. Clicking, typing and forms only with permission.

optBlockedHelp.message: Hermes may do nothing here, not even read (subdomains included).

optBadDomain.message: Please enter a domain such as example.com

pairTitle.message: Hermes wants to use a browser

pairText.message: Use this browser for Hermes? Click Connect in the browser Hermes should work in.

optBrowserNameHelp.message: Shown to Hermes when several browsers are connected to the relay (e.g. Desktop, Laptop).

looseText.message: A settings change wants to allow: $LIST$. Confirm only if you made this change yourself (e.g. in the Hermes settings).

looseEnabled.message: Turn on Hermes in the browser

optSafetyHelp.message: How much Hermes may do in its tabs. Changing a single switch makes it a custom setting.

tier_read_desc.message: Read, find, take screenshots and scroll in its own and shared tabs. No clicking, typing, scripts or opening pages.

tier_standard_desc.message: Click, type, open pages, run scripts, upload. No passwords; scripts only read on websites without approval.

tier_extended_desc.message: Like Standard, plus: scripts may change things everywhere, typing in embedded frames of other websites, closing shared tabs.

tier_full_desc.message: Everything, including entering passwords, and no question per website.

tier_custom_desc.message: Your own combination of the switches below.

safety_act_desc.message: Clicks, typing, keys, form fields, confirming dialogs.

safety_navigate_desc.message: Open new tabs and load addresses.

safety_upload_desc.message: Put files and screenshots into file fields.

safety_download_desc.message: Save recordings (GIF) to the download folder.

safety_devtools_desc.message: Read console messages and network requests.

safety_scriptWrites_desc.message: Off: on websites without approval, scripts can only read (no sending, no popups).

safety_frameTyping_desc.message: Typing into frames of other websites, often sign-in and payment widgets.

safety_passwords_desc.message: Typing into password fields. Hermes can then enter credentials that are in the chat or its context.

safety_closeShared_desc.message: Also close tabs you shared, not only its own.

warnPasswords.message: Caution: Hermes can then enter credentials that are in the chat or its context – for example passwords you told it or that it read somewhere. Turn this on only if Hermes should sign in for you.

tamperTitle.message: The page is hiding the Hermes overlay

tamperText.message: $HOST$ keeps removing the Hermes overlay, so you may not see what Hermes does in the tab. If in doubt, stop it with the toolbar icon.
